mod.slabbed.name: Slabbed
slabbed.settings.title: Slabbed Settings
slabbed.settings.pot_seat.flush.tooltip: Flower pots sit right on the surface you can see, with no gap. This only changes pots you place from now on.
Flower pots keep the small gap vanilla leaves above the surface. This only changes pots you place from now on, and on a server it is the server's setting that decides.
slabbed.report.explanation: Open a new issue at github.com/peetsamods/slabbed in your browser. GitHub requires an account. You add the symptoms and reproduction steps, then submit it yourself. Submitted issues are public.
slabbed.report.versions: Only these client version details will be prefilled (server versions are not collected):
slabbed.report.privacy: No logs, mod list, player identifiers, server addresses, chat, local paths or world data are included. Nothing is sent until you choose Open GitHub.
slabbed.report.ready: Review the details above before opening GitHub. Cancel or Escape closes this screen without sending anything.
slabbed.report.requested: Browser opening requested. If it did not open, copy the safe report link below and paste it into your browser. No issue has been submitted by Slabbed.
slabbed.report.failed: The browser could not be opened. Copy the safe report link below and paste it into your browser.
